description: This Java class 'HtmlWidget' is part of the OFBiz widget modeling framework. It handles rendering of HTML templates, including support for FreeMarker templates, HTML template decorators, and multi-block rendering with script extraction. It defines nested classes for template handling, rendering logic, and widget decoration, and manages external dependencies on various OFBiz utility classes, FreeMarker, Jsoup, and servlet APIs.

classes.name: HtmlWidget
classes.description: Main class for rendering HTML widgets, supporting template inclusion, decoration, and multi-block processing with script extraction.

classes.name: ExtendedWrapper
classes.description: Custom BeansWrapper for FreeMarker to handle String and Collection encoding for HTML.

classes.name: StringHtmlWrapperForFtl
classes.description: Wrapper for String objects to encode as HTML in FreeMarker templates.

classes.name: CollectionHtmlWrapperForFtl
classes.description: Wrapper for Collections to encode as HTML in FreeMarker templates.

classes.name: HtmlTemplate
classes.description: Represents an HTML template widget, supporting inline FTL and external template rendering.

classes.name: HtmlTemplateDecorator
classes.description: Represents a decorator for HTML templates, allowing section-based rendering.

classes.name: HtmlTemplateDecoratorSection
classes.description: Represents a section within an HTML template decorator, containing sub-widgets.
